name: Kitchen Remodel
shortDescription: Complete kitchen remodeling from design to installation.
cardDescription: Complete kitchen remodeling from design to installation.
summary: Kitchen & Flooring Depot is a kitchen remodeling company in Newington, CT, helping homeowners turn outdated kitchens into spaces that work and look great. As custom kitchen remodelers, we handle design, cabinets, countertops, flooring and installation.

sections.title: Always Wanted
sections.body: The kitchen is the heart of the home, and that’s why it’s so important to have a kitchen that meets your family’s needs. When you remodel your kitchen, you can create a space that does just that. At Kitchen & Flooring Depot in Newington, CT, we offer kitchen cabinets, flooring, backsplashes, sinks, faucets, and countertops that help you create the kitchen of your dreams. We also offer a free in-store design and estimate.

sections.title: Our Expertise
sections.body: When you work with Kitchen & Flooring Depot to create your new kitchen, you won’t have to worry about pushy contractors trying to tell you what is best for your family. Instead, we help you select cabinets, sinks, and fixtures that work with your family’s routine — some families need a large countertop for prepping, and others need two sinks to keep up with a rotating pile of dishes. We have hundreds of colors and styles for cabinets so that you can choose something that works for you.

sections.title: Locally Owned and Operated Family Business
sections.body: Kitchen & Flooring Depot is not a large company, so we keep our overhead costs low and pass those savings on to you. We have American-made cabinets that are fully assembled and ready to deliver within three working days. When you’re ready to install a high-quality, customized kitchen in your home, Kitchen & Flooring Depot should be your first call. We can also install all of our products, from flooring to countertops, sinks, and faucets.

pricingNote: Free in-store design and estimate. Request a quote — published package prices are not available on the source site.
